I'm a solo developer working full-time on a side project that makes ~$4,000/month in revenue. I want to quit my job and go full-time indie, but I'm worried about health insurance, inconsistent income, and burnout.

What are the two most important things I should realistically do before making the leap in 2026? Give a short, practical answer.

1. Secure health insurance coverage that works for you—either through an individual plan, marketplace subsidies, or a spouse’s policy—to eliminate financial risk if income dips.  
2. Build a 9–12 month operating reserve (covering expenses + taxes) and validate that your $4k/month can reliably grow to ~$6k+ by mid-2026 via pricing tests, retention improvements, or new revenue streams.
